caption: The drawing depicts a single, small metallic object positioned in the center of a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be an antique mechanical part, consisting of a brownish, solid base with some angular and curved components, and a thin, elongated wire extending upward from the base, which forms an open, roughly diamond-shaped loop with a four-lobed flower or cross-shaped structure at the top. The object is rendered in shades of brown, gray, and black, with slight shading to indicate form and dimension. The rest of the paper is empty except for the artist's signature, "Emil T. Manns," located near the lower right-hand corner in small, neat cursive script.
title: Skirt Hook
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
